summary.text: Kyle Schoenfish is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 19 who assumed office in January 2020 after serving in the state House from 2013 to 2020, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the Senate Education Committee in the 2025-2026 session.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Schoenfish represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 19 from 2013 to 2020 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 6, 2020, succeeding Stace Nelson.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Education Committee and is assigned to the Senate Local Government Committee and the Senate Transportation Committee.
